notes.title: Big System Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36339307/c8650713d8f33a7a7ce26423a3b6de36af8e171e.jpg

We have repaired most / all of our wallpaper systems.

Wallpaper design turned out to be something more difficult than we thought. Animated wallpapers for Windows 10 require some system settings. Despite many of messages, someone still missed them and problems began.

After many tries, the Big System update is ready. Most problems have probably been fixed.

90% of negative reviews describe what has been fixed:

-I can't control the wallpaper
-I can't turn off the wallpaper
-I can't uninstall this wallpaper
-My menu disappear
-Where is Taskbar to enable the second menu?
-The wallpaper is in window
-False antivirus alert
-Problem with Inputapp.exe process
-3DM website runs on my screen
-Wallpaper won't pause when I start the game
-and more

These problems should be fixed now!

In addition, the new system recognizes if the Windows 10 settings are not correct. After detecting, the wallpaper will automatically change them or show you a video on how to set it. The wallpaper itself will open a window to change the settings to "adjust the best appearance", then click the green "DONE".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36339307/cae73aecef41355cba292522b764ea27aa909939.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36339307/efea90b7df85eb47b84467571d2a7c1534e0d207.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36339307/9fc63caa3eb358af5a0cae8867e8aee23c424796.jpg

There are more patches but the competition is not sleeping so we will keep them to ourselves.

The user with the correct settings will not see the difference at the beginning but in the end, the project will work much better with it.

We are very pleased that finally, we have created the system with which we are satisfied.

Everything has been tested on many PCs and everything works as it should. If you have any problems, please write below. We will fix immediately.

Some programs may still block our projects, but this is very, very rare.

Please update our project and enjoy!

I would also like to apologize to those who had problems with the settings. Creating wallpaper requires certain technologies but now everything should play.

Thank you also for the support of our users. Your suggestions have helped us a lot and today you can see the effects. Thanks.

Best Regards,

3DM
